worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.summary: Scatters a swarm of leaves that bend after the target; because the leaves chase, they always land. Envelop fans them in a full ring that closes from every side; Direct darts them in from a forward cone.
worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.use.0: Send a bending swarm after one target
worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.use.1: Surround a target so there is no way out
worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.use.2: Stay on a target that keeps its distance
worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.descriptio: %2$s leaves scatter at about %1$s damage each; defence, type matchup and crit are settled on the hit.
Each leaf turns up to %1$s degrees per tick at %2$s blocks/tick, locking targets within %3$s blocks.
Each leaf has a %1$s block collision radius.
worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.envelop.on: Envelop: leaves fan from a full ring with 2 extra leaves and a stronger turn, closing from every side; each leaf is slower, lighter, and windup is 2 ticks longer.
worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.envelop.of: Direct: leaves dart in from a forward cone, faster and about 35%% heavier.
worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s then costs %4$s PP, recover %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.growth.0: At level %1$s: leaf power %2$s and %3$s leaves.
worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.growth.1: At level %1$s: leaf power %2$s and turn %3$s degrees/tick.
worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.preference: On (Envelop): leaves fan from a full ring with 2 extra leaves and a stronger turn, closing from every side, but each leaf is slower and lighter and windup/cooldown are longer. Off (Direct): leaves dart in from a forward cone, faster and about 35%% heavier.
Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of scattering. Larger values open from further.
On: a moving enemy is preferred, because the leaves bend across its path; off: order it like a plain ranged attack.
